tool_input.command:
$form = 'username=nacos&password={{ov_privacy:default:viking://~/privacy/credential/nacos-taicang-dev#/values/password}}'
$login = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://192.168.1.12:8848/nacos/v1/auth/login' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' -Body $form -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 15
$auth = $login.Content | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
$token = [string]$auth.accessToken
$url = 'http://192.168.1.12:8848/nacos/v1/cs/configs?dataId=application-dev.yml&group=DEFAULT_GROUP&tenant=zscloud&accessToken=' + [uri]::EscapeDataString($token)
$response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -Method Get -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 15
'APPLICATION_CONFIG_HTTP=' + [int]$response.StatusCode
if ([int]$response.StatusCode -eq 200) {
  $text = [string]$response.Content
  $jdbc = [regex]::Matches($text, '(?im)^\s*[^#\r\n]*jdbc:[^\r\n]+')
  'APPLICATION_CONFIG_LENGTH=' + $text.Length
  'JDBC_URL_COUNT=' + $jdbc.Count
  foreach ($match in $jdbc) { 'JDBC=' + (($match.Value -replace '(?i)(password|pwd)=([^;&,\s]+)','$1=[redacted]') -replace '(:[^:/@\s]+)@','$1@[redacted]') }
  $drivers = [regex]::Matches($text, '(?im)^\s*(driver-class-name|driverClassName)\s*:\s*([^\r\n]+)')
  foreach ($match in $drivers) { 'DRIVER=' + $match.Groups[2].Value.Trim() }
  $users = [regex]::Matches($text, '(?im)^\s*username\s*:\s*([^\r\n]+)')
  'DB_USERNAME_FIELD_COUNT=' + $users.Count
  'DB_PASSWORD_FIELD_COUNT=' + ([regex]::Matches($text, '(?im)^\s*password\s*:\s*\S+')).Count
}
